docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY QUAN, HANK AS TO DEFENDANT MARTINEZ, ADRIANA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-31-2016 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF QUAN, HANK AS TO DEFENDANT MARTINEZ, ADRIANA
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED APR-15-2016, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT MARTINEZ, ADRIANA

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAY-31-2016. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT, AFTER MATTER WAS HEARD, THE COURT TAKES THE MATTER UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF MAY-31-2016 BY JUDGE PRO TEMPORE SAM LAW. PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RETAINED. CLERK S. RAVINANTAPRICHA. NOT REPORTED. (506)
STIPULATION TO USE JUDGE PRO TEM AND ORDER FILED BY QUAN, HANK MARTINEZ, ADRIANA
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-31-2016 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF QUAN, HANK RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MARTINEZ, ADRIANA $465.29 PRINCIPAL, $65.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $530.29, THE COURT FOUND DEFENDANT TO BE 50 PERCENT LIABLE SINCE SHE WAS NOT TO DRIVER, BUT ONLY NEGLIGENTLY ENTRUSTED THE VEHICLE TO HER FRIEND WHO WAS NEGLIGENT IN OPERATION THE VEHICLE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS, SEE JUDGMENT ATTACHED PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
D.M.V. CERTIFICATE OF FACTS RE UNSATISFIED JUDGMENT FILED BY PLAINTIFF QUAN, HANK AS TO DEFENDANT MARTINEZ, ADRIANA
